name: s81dv_pvlocal_d32c-d32c-COMMIT
purpose: Structural alternate to measured phase DFFE reset hold stall: fold epoch phase into a 64-state one-hot writer, retaining exactly32 data slots and active age18 at K17. Source controls stay native-owned; total reset4 and body129.6x194.4 unchanged. Adds control FF area, to be measured. No clock or timing-rule change.
